item.title: A whole stand at a tennis match filming on phones, and one person recording in Meta glasses while still watching the game.
item.dc:creator: ShikshanNivesh
item.content:encoded:
A whole stand at a tennis match filming on phones, and one person recording in Meta glasses while still watching the game. Every one of those phones was designed before AI. My theory is that Meta ($META) is eventually going after Apple ($AAPL) and Samsung with this.
Mark Zuckerberg said something close to this on Meta's results call in January. He compared AI glasses today to the moment smartphones arrived. It was only a matter of time, he said, until every flip phone became a smartphone. He also said sales of Meta's glasses more than tripled in 2025. It will not happen soon, because Apple has more than 2.5 billion active devices and about $146 billion in cash and securities. But people using their phones less is exactly what Meta is building for.
